title: Left Front Wheel Speed Sensor Circuit
description: The ABS module detects a malfunction in the circuit for the left front wheel speed sensor.
possibleCauses: Faulty left front wheel speed sensor
Debris on the wheel speed sensor tone ring
solutions: Inspect and replace the left front wheel speed sensor
Repair wiring harness or connector
Clean the tone ring and sensor tip
Replace tone ring or wheel bearing if damaged

title: ABS Pump Motor Relay Circuit
description: The ABS module has detected an open, short, or failure in the ABS pump motor relay circuit.
solutions: Check and replace ABS pump fuses
Test and replace the ABS pump relay
Clean relay contacts
Inspect ABS module wiring

title: Stability Control System Disabled
description: The stability control system has been disabled by the control module, usually due to a fault in a related system.
possibleCauses: Engine misfire or performance codes present (check engine light on)
solutions: Scan and repair any engine (P-codes) first
Diagnose related ABS or traction control codes
Calibrate steering angle sensor
Clear codes and test drive

title: ABS Pump Motor Control Circuit
description: The ABS module is unable to properly control the ABS hydraulic pump motor.
possibleCauses: Poor electrical connection to the ABS pump
solutions: Check high-amp fuses
Inspect ABS pump connector and ground
Replace the ABS pump assembly
Replace or rebuild the EBCM

title: Steering Wheel Position Sensor Circuit
description: The control module is receiving an erratic or missing signal from the steering wheel position sensor.
possibleCauses: Sensor out of calibration after an alignment
Damaged wiring in the steering column
solutions: Perform SAS calibration procedure with a scan tool
Inspect and replace steering wheel position sensor
Check wiring harness in the steering column
Perform a wheel alignment

title: ABS Hydraulic Pump Motor Circuit
description: The ABS module detects a lack of voltage or circuit continuity to the hydraulic pump motor.
possibleCauses: Blown ABS motor fuse or fusible link
Internal failure of the ABS hydraulic pump
solutions: Test all ABS-related fuses
Clean the ABS module ground wire
Check for power at the pump connector
Replace the ABS pump and motor assembly
